answer: Bindings are kept in gale, verified in pulse, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the wander check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Repeating the trick 28 times costs 7 separate deposits and 10 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
